firm_data.firm_description: Gitto & Niefer, LLP provides experienced attorneys in workers’ compensation representation in New York and Pennsylvania, appearing before the New York State Workers’ Compensation Board since 1986. The firm focuses on handling a high volume of cases efficiently and effectively on behalf of self-insured employers and insurance carriers.
notable_facts: Partners have experience in bringing precedent-setting cases to the appellate level on issues of statewide concern in New York.
The firm's work is primarily on behalf of self-insured employers and insurance carriers.

email.subject: AI for Gitto & Niefer, LLP - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Kathryn,

Since 1986, your team has handled a high volume of workers' compensation cases for self-insured employers and insurance carriers across New York and Pennsylvania. That efficiency focus is exactly what we're built for.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform designed for law firms managing BigLaw-scale demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your Binghamton office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar practices compete.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
